scope: Architecture-related official/source-family audit for London, NYC, and Belfast, 2008-2026. Counts use architecture_milestones seed and generated yearly atlas events whose provenance/source ids point back to that seed/source family.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: GLA Planning London Datahub / borough planning application records
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: Registered in sources.json but absent from architecture seed counts; current seed relies on public project pages and NHLE rather than application-level official records.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Use Datahub application id plus borough/LPA, decision/validated dates, and document links as administrative events; never treat permission as completion.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: London Development Database / residential approvals/completions dashboards
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: No direct seed counts from LDD despite many named built-environment milestones.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Use scheme id/site and permission/start/completion fields to corroborate major housing or mixed-use milestones.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: Borough planning portals and committee decision notices
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: Many borough council pages appear as generic public-page evidence, but no normalized borough-portal source ids or application references.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Require local authority, application/reference number, decision date, and document URL before ingesting planning-stage events.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: Building control/completion certificates and official completions
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: Opening/completion claims are mostly project/news pages; administrative completion evidence is thin.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Prefer completion certificate/building-control or GLA completion fields for built/opening events when available.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: Mayoral development corporations and public estate bodies (LLDC, OPDC, NHS estates, DfE/Get Information About Schools)
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: Public realm, schools, health, and regeneration entries are mixed into generic architecture pages.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Create specific source ids for each official body to avoid broad bucket duplicates and improve licence review.

duplicate_risk_patterns: Generic public-page source ids aggregate many publishers; require publisher + canonical URL + record_id namespace so later official-source ingestion can match instead of duplicating.

Opening, completion, listing/designation, planning permission, refurbishment, and reopening are different event types; duplicate checks should include event_type/status_phase, but also flag same site/date across event types for reviewer triage.
Source URLs with query strings, trailing slashes, news mirrors, and renamed pages should be canonicalized before duplicate comparison.
source_record_id values must be namespaced by source_id and stable upstream id; slug-only ids are collision-prone across rounds.
Exact title matching misses near duplicates where worker batches rewrite titles; use normalized title + city + date + approximate coordinate/site label as a soft duplicate gate.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: NYC DOB filings, permits, and Certificates of Occupancy
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: Rich DOB sources are registered but absent from current architecture seed counts.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Require job/permit/CO ids, BIN/BBL, status date type, and distinguish filing/permit/temporary CO/final CO from physical completion.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: DCP ZAP / ULURP / CEQR land-use records
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: Current seed is mostly LPC and public project pages rather than official zoning/environmental-review workflow records.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Ingest project/action ids and milestone dates as planning-process events with caveats, not built outcomes.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: DCP PLUTO/MapPLUTO and archived Bytes releases
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: Parcel/building-stock snapshots are registered but not used as corroborating architecture source families.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Use BBL/BIN/year-built/land-use changes for corroboration and geometry joins, with snapshot-vintage caveats.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: HPD housing and capital project delivery datasets
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: Affordable/public housing delivery is likely underrepresented by official HPD records.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Use project/building ids and completion/finance closing dates where available; keep finance milestone separate from occupancy.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: NYC DDC / Parks / Libraries / SCA capital projects
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: Civic facilities appear through generic public pages without normalized agency project ids.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Create agency-specific source ids and require contract/project number where exposed.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: NI Planning Portal / application-level planning records
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: NI planning statistics are registered, but application-level planning records are not represented in architecture seed counts.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Require application reference, decision/status date, address/site, authority, and document URL; keep planning consent distinct from construction/opening.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: Belfast City Council open data and committee/minutes records as normalized source ids
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: Council evidence is mostly folded into belfast-architecture-public-pages rather than specific official source ids.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Split council minutes, open data, leisure/parks, and capital projects into stable source families to reduce broad-bucket duplicate risk.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: Building control/completion and property/address base sources
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: No official completion/building-control source family appears in the seed.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: If available under usable terms, use completion certificate/building control records as built/opening corroboration, with address/UPRN or parcel keys.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: DfC/HED heritage records beyond listed-building point records
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: HED listed-building records are present, but conservation-area, scheduled monument, grants/restoration programmes are not separated.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Separate statutory designation, restoration grant, and project-delivery records; do not let listing amendments duplicate restoration/opening events.

underrepresented_official_source_familie.family: DfI/Translink public project and transport estate sources
underrepresented_official_source_familie.gap: Transport-related architecture/public-realm milestones are not strongly represented as architecture source families.
underrepresented_official_source_familie.recommendation: Use DfI/Translink project ids and opening dates for station/interchange/public-realm works, not generic architecture pages.

ingestion_recommendations.rule: Require canonical duplicate key before append
ingestion_recommendations.reason: Current exact key only catches identical titles; architecture batches often rewrite event wording.
Official pages can describe the same project with different titles or URLs.

ingestion_recommendations.rule: Keep administrative milestones separate from built/opening milestones
ingestion_recommendations.reason: Prevents planning or heritage records from duplicating public opening/completion claims.

ingestion_recommendations.rule: Split generic architecture-public-pages into publisher-specific source ids during promotion
ingestion_recommendations.reason: Broad source ids hide official family gaps and make licence/provenance review too coarse.

ingestion_recommendations.rule: Reject or quarantine candidates missing source_record_id or source_url
ingestion_recommendations.reason: Without both URL and upstream id/slug, same project can be re-added by later rounds.
